recipe_steps: 1. Add 1 cup rolled oats to a blender and blend on high for 30 seconds until a fine flour forms.
2. Add 3 eggs, 1 large banana, 1 scoop vanilla whey protein, 1 tsp baking powder, and 1/3 cup milk. Blend 45 seconds until smooth. Let batter rest 5 minutes to thicken.
3. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat (about 350°F) and melt 1/2 tbsp butter, swirling to coat.
4. Pour 1/4-cup portions of batter into the pan. Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface and edges set.
5. Flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden. Repeat with remaining butter and batter, making about 6 pancakes.
6. Stack, drizzle with 2 tbsp maple syrup, and serve hot.
1. Slice 8 oz chicken breast into 1/2-inch strips.
2. In a bowl whisk 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1.5 tbsp honey, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 2 tbsp water.
3. Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and sear 4-5 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked to 165°F internal.
4. Add 1.5 cups broccoli florets and 2 tbsp water; cover and steam 2 minutes.
5. Pour in the sauce and toss 1-2 minutes until it thickens and coats everything.
6. Serve over 1.5 cups warm rice, sprinkle with 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday lunch. If forgotten, cold-water thaw Monday morning in a sealed bag, submerged, changing water every 30 min, ~40 min.
Rinse 1.5 cups raw white rice, combine with 2.25 cups water in a pot, bring to boil, cover, simmer 15 min, rest 10 min. Refrigerate to reheat for Monday and Tuesday meals.

meals.recipe_name: Seared Salmon with Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipe_steps: 1. Peel and cube 2 potatoes; boil in salted water 15 minutes until fork-tender. Drain.
2. Mash potatoes with 2 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup milk, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1/2 tsp salt. Keep warm.
3. Pat salmon dry, season both sides with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Place salmon skin-side down and sear 4 minutes without moving. Flip and cook 3 minutes to 130°F internal.
5. Add asparagus to the pan the last 3 minutes, tossing until bright and tender.
6. Plate salmon over mash with asparagus, squeeze 1/2 lemon over top.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday dinner. Cold-water thaw Monday afternoon ~30 min if needed.

recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
2. Top with 1/2 cup mixed berries.
3. Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top.
4. Sprinkle 1/3 cup granola and 2 tbsp chopped almonds. Serve immediately.
1. Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop protein powder, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana, and 1 cup ice to a blender.
2. Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth and creamy. Serve immediately.
1. Dice 1/2 bell pepper and 1/4 onion. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté 3 minutes until soft.
2. Add 1/2 cup black beans and warm 1 minute.
3. Whisk 4 eggs and pour in; stir gently with a spatula 2-3 minutes until nearly set.
4. Fold in 1/2 cup cottage cheese and 1/4 cup cheddar; cook 1 minute until melted.
5. Plate and top with 3 tbsp salsa.
1. Cut 7 oz sushi-grade tuna into 1/2-inch cubes.
2. In a bowl toss tuna with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, and 1 tsp sriracha. Let sit 5 minutes.
3. Dice 1/2 cucumber and 1/2 avocado; slice 2 green onions.
4. Warm 1.5 cups rice and add to a bowl.
5. Top with marinated tuna, cucumber, avocado, and green onion. Sprinkle 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz sushi-grade tuna from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday lunch. Keep cold; use within a day of thawing since it's eaten raw.

recipe_steps: 1. Slice 8 oz flank steak thinly against the grain. Toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce.
2. Cook 6 oz udon noodles per package (about 4 min boiling), drain, set aside.
3. Slice 1/2 bell pepper, 1 carrot, and 1 cup broccoli. Mince 2 garlic cloves.
4. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Sear beef 2 minutes until browned; remove.
5. Add 1 tbsp oil, stir-fry vegetables 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
6. Return beef, add noodles, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, and garlic. Toss 2 minutes over high heat and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner. Cold-water thaw Tuesday afternoon ~40 min if needed.

recipe_steps: 1. Add 1 cup cottage cheese to a bowl.
2. Top with 1/2 cup pineapple chunks and 2 tbsp chopped walnuts.
3. Drizzle 1 tbsp honey and serve.
1. The night before, combine 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 3/4 cup milk, 1 tbsp chia seeds in a jar. Stir well, cover, refrigerate overnight.
2. In the morning stir, top with 1 tbsp peanut butter, and eat.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday night combine 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 3/4 cup milk, 1 tbsp chia seeds in a jar; stir, cover, refrigerate for Tuesday.

recipe_steps: 1. For tortillas: mix 1.25 cups flour, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp of the oil and 1/2 cup warm water into a dough. Knead 5 min, rest 20 min. Divide into 2, roll thin, cook each in a dry skillet over medium-high 1 min per side.
2. Season 5 oz ground turkey with 1/2 tsp paprika and pinch salt. Cook in a skillet over medium heat 6 minutes until browned to 165°F. Remove.
3. Whisk 3 eggs, scramble in the same pan 2 minutes until just set.
4. Lay tortillas flat, divide turkey, eggs, 1/4 cup cheddar, and 3 tbsp salsa.
5. Fold in sides and roll into burritos. Toast seam-side down in the pan 1 minute each side to seal.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday breakfast.
Tuesday night mix 1.25 cups flour, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp oil, 1/2 cup warm water; knead 5 min, wrap, refrigerate. Bring to room temp before rolling Wednesday.

recipe_steps: 1. Make 2 tortillas: mix 1.25 cups flour, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp oil, 1/2 cup warm water; knead, rest 20 min, roll thin, cook 1 min per side in dry skillet.
2. Season 7 oz chicken breast with salt. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high 5 minutes per side to 165°F. Slice.
3. Chop 2 cups romaine and toss with 3 tbsp Caesar dressing and 1/4 cup parmesan.
4. Lay tortillas flat, divide salad and sliced chicken, roll tightly, slice in half.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch.
Tuesday night mix 1.25 cups flour, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp oil, 1/2 cup warm water; knead 5 min, wrap, refrigerate. Room temp before rolling Wednesday.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Chops with Apple & Sweet Potato
recipe_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Cube 1 sweet potato, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and salt, roast 25 minutes.
2. Pat pork chop dry, season both sides with salt and 1 tsp rosemary.
3. Heat 1 tbsp butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high. Sear chop 3 minutes per side.
4. Add 1 more tbsp butter, 2 smashed garlic cloves, and sliced apple. Baste chop, then transfer skillet to oven 6 minutes to 145°F internal.
5. Rest pork 5 minutes; serve with apples and roasted sweet potato.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 9 oz bone-in pork chop from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday dinner.

recipe_steps: 1. Drain 1 can tuna and mix with 2 tbsp Greek yogurt and juice of 1/4 lemon.
2. Slice 1/2 cucumber.
3. Top 10 crackers with tuna salad and cucumber slices. Serve.
1. Add 1 cup milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein, 3/4 cup berries, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, and 1 tbsp honey to a blender.
2. Blend 40 seconds until smooth. Serve.

1. For the bagel: mix 1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 cup warm water into a stiff dough. Knead 8 min, proof 1 hr (done ahead). Shape into a ring, boil 1 min per side, bake at 425°F for 18 min.
2. Whisk 4 eggs with a pinch of salt. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-low.
3. Add eggs and stir slowly 3 minutes for soft curds; fold in 1 tbsp chives.
4. Slice and toast the bagel, spread 2 tbsp cream cheese.
5. Top with scrambled eggs and 3 oz smoked salmon.

prep_tasks.instructions: Wednesday night mix 1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 cup warm water; knead 8 min, place in oiled bowl, cover, cold ferment in fridge overnight. Thursday morning shape, boil, and bake.

recipe_steps: 1. Peel 8 oz shrimp. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and sear shrimp 2 minutes until pink; remove.
2. Scramble 2 eggs in the wok 1 minute; push aside.
3. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 3/4 cup peas and carrots; stir-fry 2 minutes.
4. Add 1.5 cups cooked rice and stir-fry 3 minutes until heated and slightly crisp.
5. Return shrimp, add 3 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp sesame oil. Toss 1 minute, top with sliced green onion.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday lunch, or cold-water thaw Thursday morning ~15 min.
Rinse 1.5 cups raw white rice, combine with 2.25 cups water, boil, cover, simmer 15 min, rest 10 min. Refrigerate day-old rice fries best. Covers Thursday and Friday.

recipe_steps: 1. For bun: mix 1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 cup warm water; knead 8 min, proof 1 hr (done ahead). Shape into 1 bun, proof 30 min, bake 375°F for 15 min.
2. Preheat oven to 425°F. Cut 1 potato into fries, toss with 1 tbsp oil and salt, roast 30 minutes flipping once.
3. Form 8 oz bison into a patty, season with salt. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high, cook 3-4 minutes per side to 145°F.
4. Add cheddar slice the last minute to melt.
5. Slice bun, layer lettuce, tomato, and patty. Serve with fries.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner.
Wednesday night mix 1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 cup warm water; knead 8 min, cover, cold ferment in fridge overnight. Thursday shape, proof 30 min, bake.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Peanut Butter Dip with Apple
recipe_steps: 1. Mix 3/4 cup Greek yogurt, 1.5 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp honey, and 1/4 tsp cinnamon in a bowl.
2. Slice 1 apple and serve alongside for dipping.
1. Blend 1 cup cottage cheese, 1 scoop chocolate protein, and 2 tbsp milk in a food processor 60 seconds until completely smooth.
2. Spoon into a bowl, top with 1 tbsp chocolate chips, and eat immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Spinach Feta Egg White Omelette with Toast
recipe_steps: 1. For bread: mix 1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup warm water; knead 8 min, proof 1 hr, shape, proof 30 min, bake at 400°F for 22 min (done ahead). Slice 2 pieces and toast.
2. Whisk 2 whole eggs and 4 egg whites. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium.
3. Add 1.5 cups spinach, wilt 1 minute.
4. Pour in eggs, cook 2 minutes until edges set. Sprinkle 1/3 cup feta over one half.
5. Fold omelette over, cook 1 more minute. Serve with buttered toast.

prep_tasks.instructions: Thursday evening make bread dough (1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup warm water), knead, proof, shape and bake, cool. Store in bread bag for Friday toast.

recipe_steps: 1. Dice 8 oz chicken thigh, toss with 1 tsp cumin and salt.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and cook chicken 6-7 minutes to 165°F.
3. Warm 1.5 cups rice, 1/2 cup black beans, and 1/2 cup corn.
4. Build the bowl: rice, beans, corn, chicken, sliced avocado, and 1/4 cup salsa.
5. Squeeze 1/2 lime over the top and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken thigh from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Garlic Butter Steak with Rice Pilaf
recipe_steps: 1. Pat 9 oz sirloin dry, season generously with salt and pepper. Rest at room temp 15 min.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking. Sear steak 3 minutes per side.
3. Reduce heat, add 2 tbsp butter, 3 smashed garlic cloves, 1 tsp thyme. Baste steak 1-2 minutes to 130°F. Rest 5 min.
4. Steam 1.5 cups green beans 4 minutes; toss with 1 tbsp butter.
5. Warm 1.5 cups rice. Slice steak and serve over rice with green beans.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 9 oz sirloin steak from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday dinner.

recipe_steps: 1. Lay out 5 oz turkey slices, spread thinly with 1 tbsp mustard.
2. Place a strip of cheddar on each and roll up.
3. Serve roll-ups with 8 crackers.

prep_tasks.instructions: If using frozen sliced turkey, move to fridge Thursday night for Friday snack.

recipe_steps: 1. Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop protein, 2 tbsp almonds, 1 banana, and 1/4 cup oats to a blender.
2. Blend on high 50 seconds until smooth. Serve.
1. Dice 1 potato, 1/2 bell pepper, 1/4 onion. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high, cook potatoes 8 minutes until golden.
2. Add peppers, onion, 1/2 tsp paprika, salt; cook 4 minutes. Push to side.
3. Season 5 oz sirloin, sear in the pan 2-3 minutes per side to 130°F. Rest and slice.
4. In the same pan with 1 tbsp oil, fry 3 eggs sunny-side up 3 minutes.
5. Plate hash, sliced steak, and eggs together.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz sirloin steak from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday breakfast.

recipe_steps: 1. Season 7 oz salmon with salt. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high, sear 4 minutes skin-side, 3 minutes flesh side to 130°F. Flake into chunks.
2. Toss 1.5 cups warm rice with 1 tbsp rice vinegar.
3. Slice 1/2 avocado and 1/2 cucumber; cut 1 nori sheet into strips.
4. Build bowl: rice, salmon, avocado, cucumber, nori.
5. Drizzle 2 tbsp soy sauce, sprinkle 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday lunch.
Rinse 1.5 cups sushi rice, cook with 1.75 cups water 15 min, rest 10 min, refrigerate. Reheat and season Saturday.

recipe_steps: 1. Bring pizza dough to room temp (made ahead). Preheat oven to 500°F with a baking sheet inside.
2. Season 6 oz chicken with salt, sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high 5 min per side to 165°F, slice thin.
3. Stretch dough on parchment to a 12-inch round. Spread 1/2 cup tomato sauce mixed with 2 minced garlic cloves.
4. Top with 1.5 cups mozzarella and sliced chicken. Drizzle 1 tbsp oil.
5. Slide onto the hot sheet, bake 10-12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese bubbles.
6. Top with fresh basil, slice, and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner.
Thursday night mix 2 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1 tsp salt, 3/4 cup warm water, 1 tbsp oil; knead 8 min, oil, cover, cold ferment in fridge 48 hrs for flavor. Pull out 1 hr before baking Saturday.

recipe_steps: 1. Layer 1/2 cup Greek yogurt in a glass.
2. Add half the granola and half the berries.
3. Repeat layers with remaining yogurt, granola, and berries.
4. Drizzle 1 tbsp honey and serve.
1. Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana to a blender with a few ice cubes.
2. Blend 45 seconds until smooth. Serve.
1. Use homemade bread (baked ahead), slice 4 thick pieces.
2. Whisk 3 eggs, 1 scoop vanilla protein, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tsp cinnamon in a shallow dish until smooth.
3. Soak each bread slice 20 seconds per side.
4. Melt 1.5 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat. Cook slices 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
5. Plate, top with 1/2 cup berries and 2 tbsp maple syrup.

prep_tasks.instructions: Saturday evening make bread (1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup warm water), knead, proof, shape, bake at 400°F 22 min. Slightly stale bread soaks best for French toast Sunday.

recipe_steps: 1. Bake sub roll (dough made ahead): shape 1.75 cups flour dough into a 7-inch loaf, proof 30 min, bake at 400°F 18 min.
2. Mix 8 oz ground turkey, 1 egg, 1/4 cup breadcrumbs, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp italian seasoning, salt. Roll into 6 meatballs.
3. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium, brown meatballs 6 minutes turning, until 165°F.
4. Add 3/4 cup marinara, simmer 4 minutes.
5. Split roll, add meatballs and sauce, top with 1/2 cup mozzarella. Broil 2 minutes to melt.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch.
Saturday night mix 1.75 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 3/4 cup warm water; knead 8 min, cover, cold ferment overnight. Shape and bake Sunday.

meals.recipe_name: Honey Garlic Glazed Shrimp with Quinoa
recipe_steps: 1. Rinse 3/4 cup quinoa, cook with 1.5 cups water 15 minutes until fluffy.
2. Peel 9 oz shrimp. Whisk 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes.
3. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear shrimp 2 minutes per side.
4. Add sliced zucchini, cook 3 minutes.
5. Pour in glaze, toss 2 minutes until sticky. Squeeze 1/2 lemon.
6. Serve over quinoa.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 9 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner, or cold-water thaw Sunday afternoon ~15 min.

recipe_steps: 1. Toast 2 slices of homemade bread.
2. Spread 3/4 cup cottage cheese over the toast.
3. Top with sliced 1/2 tomato, drizzle 1 tsp olive oil, and crack black pepper. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Mixed Berry Greek Yogurt Protein Shake
recipe_steps: 1. Add 1 cup milk, 1 scoop protein, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 3/4 cup berries, 1/4 cup oats, 1 tbsp honey to a blender.
2. Blend on high 50 seconds until smooth and thick. Serve.

pantry.item: spices (paprika, cumin, cinnamon, rosemary, thyme, italian seasoning, red pepper flakes, salt, pepper)
